leads.head: Zelensky: Ukraine sank a Russian warship off Libya
leads.sub: Kyiv says 7 sea drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi port and also hit the cargo ship Angara and a Ka-27 helicopter. All crew rescued, local officials say; UN mission calls for an inquiry.

leads.head: Seoul stocks slump as chipmakers fall
leads.sub: KOSPI dives as much as 5.8% before closing 3.3% lower; Samsung -3.1%, SK Hynix -2.5%. Taiwan's Taiex ends 2.2% higher; Tokyo shut for a holiday.

leads.head: National strike grounds all Belgian flights
leads.sub: Air traffic control halts 06:00-20:00 GMT as unions march in Brussels against EUR 10bn of budget cuts.
